about: The tools, the mining tiers and the weapons (roadmap 29.3, the tool table). A tool's durability is the swings that hit a block it can use before it breaks; its tier is the hardest block it mines (block_tier; a block not listed needs no tool). block_damage is how much one strike breaks each block (a whole number of hits is made, and a part carries to the next strike); a block it does not list takes its harvest (default 1). creature_damage is the health one strike takes from a creature. Names are the constants of VoxelGen.py (checked when the file loads), and the file is VOXEL_TOOLS or resources/voxel_tools.json.
